mapper.select: SELECT t.id, t.name, CASE WHEN tm.team_role = 1 THEN '队长' ELSE '普通成员' END AS role, tm.joined_at AS joined_at FROM team_member tm INNER JOIN team t ON t.id = tm.team_id WHERE tm.user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY tm.joined_at DESC

SELECT t.*, u.username AS owner_name, COUNT(DISTINCT tm.user_id) AS member_count, COUNT(DISTINCT d.id) AS document_count FROM team t LEFT JOIN user u ON t.owner_user_id = u.id LEFT JOIN team_member tm ON t.id = tm.team_id LEFT JOIN document d ON t.id = d.team_id
(t.name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{teamName}, '%')
AND t.status = #{status}
GROUP BY t.id, t.name, t.owner_user_id, u.username, t.status, t.created_at ORDER BY t.created_at DESC

select t.*, u.username as owner_name from team t left join user u on t.owner_user_id = u.id
t.name like concat('%', #{teamName}, '%')
and t.status in (0, 1)
